item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"`Module.__call__` and `Module.acall` are the outer invocation wrappers around `forward` and `aforward`, and both wrappers are decorated with `@with_callbacks`.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"Before invoking the implementation, `__call__` and `acall` append `self` to `settings.caller_modules` and run inside `settings.context(caller_modules=caller_modules)`.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"When `settings.track_usage` is enabled and there is no existing thread-local `usage_tracker`, `__call__` and `acall` wrap the implementation in `track_usage()`, collect total tokens, and pass those tokens plus the output to `_set_lm_usage` before returning.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"`_set_lm_usage` preserves LM-usage bookkeeping only when the module returns either a `Prediction` or a non-empty tuple whose first element is a `Prediction`; any other return shape only triggers a warning and gets no attached usage.","span_ids":["s3"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The tests confirm that the standard synchronous and asynchronous module invocation paths populate `get_lm_usage()` on returned predictions when tracking is enabled.","span_ids":["s5","s6"]},{"claim_id":"c6","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"`Module.__getattribute__` detects `forward` calls that do not come from `__call__` as direct calls and warns to use `module(...)` instead, showing that a direct implementation call does not pass through the normal wrapper path.","span_ids":["s4","s1"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":93,"end_line":110},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":112,"end_line":129},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":319,"end_line":333},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":335,"end_line":349},{"span_id":"s5","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":727,"end_line":740},{"span_id":"s6","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":770,"end_line":802}]}
